 beautyheaven crowns Best In Beauty Awards winners
 Posted In awards beauty digital By Aja Walter | November 19, 2026 - 10:47am 
 beautyheaven has announced the winners of this year's  Best In Beauty Awards , crowning winners and runners up across 53 categories.
 As beautyheaven ’s flagship awards program for the past 15 years, Best in Beauty celebrates the standout products bh 's members know, love and recommend. 
 Voting spanned four key categories: Skin Care, Makeup & Perfume, Hair, Natural, Mum & Baby, and Body & Health.
 Natio and Dermal Therapy were the standout performers, leading 14 and 13 award categories respectively, highlighting the popularity of these trusted brands among the beautyheaven community.
 So, without further ado, see a selection of the worthy winners below:
 Best Cleanser 
Winner: Natio Calm Delicate Care Cleansing Milk
Runner Up: QV Ceramides Cleanser
 Best Face Sunscreen 
Winner: Eau Thermale Avène Sunsitive® Sunscreen Fluid SPF 50+
Runner Up: NIVEA SUN UV Face Shine Control SPF 50+
 Always read the label and follow the directions for use. Wear protective clothing, a hat and sunglasses in addition to sunscreen. Reapply frequently. Avoid prolonged high-risk sun exposure. 
 Best Prestige Skin Care Product 
Winner: SkinCeuticals C E Ferulic
Runner Up: esmi Brightening 15% Vitamin C Serum
 Best Foundation 
Winner: Natio Cream to Powder Foundation
Runner Up: Clinique Even Better Makeup SPF 15
 Best Mascara 
Winner: Clinique High Impact Mascara
Runner Up: Revlon All In Lash Lift Tubing Mascara
 Best Fragrance 
Winner: Elizabeth Arden Eternal Aura Eau de Parfum
Runner Up: GLASSHOUSE FRAGRANCES Kyoto in Bloom Eau de Parfum
 Best Home Fragrance 
Winner: GLASSHOUSE FRAGRANCES Kyoto in Bloom Scented Candle
Runner Up: CIRCA Jasmine & Magnolia Soy Candle
 Best Conditioner 
Winner: John Frieda Frizz Ease Infinite Smooth Conditioner
Runner Up: Klorane Anti-Hair Loss Strengthening & Stimulating Conditioner With Quinine & Organic Edelweiss
 Best Hair Colour 
Winner: Clairol ColourStrong Zero Ammonia
Runner Up: Solfine Crema Color
 Best Hair Dryer 
Winner: Shark Beauty SpeedStyle RapidGloss Finisher & High-Velocity Dryer
Runner Up: Remington ONE™ Dry & Style Digital Hair Dryer
 Best Mum & Baby Product 
Winner: Palmer’s Massage Lotion for Stretch Marks
Runner Up: Little Étoile Soothing Barrier Lotion
 Best Product For Baby 
Winner: QV Baby Baby Gentle Wash
Runner Up: Dermal Therapy Little Bodies Eczema Wash & Shampoo
 Best Body Essential 
Winner: QV Cream
Runner Up: Dermal Therapy Sensitive Skin Lotion
 Best Nail Polish 
Winner: OPI Nail Lacquer Big Apple Red Nail Polish
Runner Up: Natio Nail Colour
 Best Natural Body Product 
Winner: Weleda Skin Food Body Lotion
Runner Up: Manicare Stainless Steel Gua Sha Tool
 Best Men’s Body Product 
Winner: DU’IT Tough Hands Fragrance Free
Runner Up: Dermal Therapy Sensitive Skin Wash
 You can find the full winners list on beautyheaven , here .
